All glories to Śrī Guru and Śrī Gaurāṅga



Kīrtan Guide

Twelfth Edition



Intended as a useful guide to kīrtans chanted at
Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh, Nabadwip,
as established by

the Founder President Āchārya
Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj

and his Successor President Āchārya
Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj



With standardised transliteration
and additional selected kīrtans from
the Maṭh’s original Bengali Śrī Gauḍīya-Gītāñjali
